description.value: Darkvision functions in magical darkness as well as mundane, and Tunnel-Dark Eyes' scent-based Perception bonus increases and extends to 60 feet.

cinderfall.incomplete: 'greater-darkvision' is a real, confirmed sense type (pf2e-source src/module/actor/creature/values.ts SENSE_TYPES) that exactly matches 'functions in magical darkness as well as mundane', and is built above. But 'Tunnel-Dark Eyes' scent-based Perception bonus increases and extends to 60 feet' states no new bonus value -- only the range is quantified, and a FlatModifier has no 'range' concept to extend. The card states a bonus/effect but gives no numeric value or formula to build a rule element from without inventing one.
